landmarks.name: Action
landmarks.description: Elevates the mandible; posterior fibres also retract it. Its tendon inserts on the coronoid process and anterior ramus.

landmarks.name: Dental relevance
landmarks.description: A primary muscle of mastication and a common contributor to jaw-clenching pain and temporomandibular disorder assessment.

landmarks.name: Action
landmarks.description: Elevates and protrudes the mandible; with the opposite side it contributes to side-to-side grinding movements.

landmarks.name: Attachment
landmarks.description: Runs from the pterygoid region to the medial surface of the mandibular angle, forming a muscular sling with masseter.

landmarks.name: Action
landmarks.description: Compresses the cheek against the teeth and gums, keeping food between the occlusal surfaces during mastication.

landmarks.name: Dental relevance
landmarks.description: Important for denture stability, cheek biting, and control of the food bolus; it is supplied by the facial nerve.

landmarks.name: Action
landmarks.description: Elevates the floor of the mouth and hyoid during swallowing; when the hyoid is fixed, it assists mandibular depression.

landmarks.name: Dental relevance
landmarks.description: Forms the muscular diaphragm of the mouth and separates the sublingual from submandibular spaces, important in spread of odontogenic infection.
